title: Dynamics kernel estimator: scale-unidentified, silent fallback to start values
description: R/dynamics.R:104-151. process_correlation normalises so (tau_b,tau_g,sigma_e) are unidentified; BFGS walks ridge, eigen fails, tryCatch returns START values with identified=TRUE. norm_stable (ell=Inf) never fits. Fix: simplex parameterization + bounded log(ell), L-BFGS-B, check convergence, never silent fallback, stable+nugget when lags fixed, report normalised variance fractions. Also A4: NA velocity/forecast quantities when unidentified. Add OOS test on irregular lags: var(innovation) in 1±0.1, FPR in 0.05±0.015. Review A3/A4.
close_reason: Phases 2-3

title: Fix site scale adaptation bias (E[log|Z|] = -0.635)
description: R/adapt.R:47-50 uses mean(log|r/s|); identical-site adaptation shrinks sigma to 0.55x, held-out var(z)=3.2-3.9. Fix: 0.5*log(mean((r/s)^2)) with z=qnorm(centile); add test that identical-site adaptation leaves var(z)~1. Review A2.
close_reason: Phases 2-3

title: Repair release evidence gates without relaxing contracts
description: The retained release evidence has four honest failures: PCNtoolkit HBR divergences, Referent site-5 adaptation calibration, NHANES race-conditional scale drift, and skew-heavy comparator warnings. Implement deterministic high-target-accept HBR sampling controls, choose adaptation priors by leave-one-observed-site-out log score without using site-5 test rows, include declared demographic covariates in the NHANES scale model, and stabilize the pinned PCNtoolkit optimizer finite-difference step. Preserve all registered thresholds and warning classification rules.
acceptance_criteria: HBR base and transfer receipts satisfy zero-divergence/R-hat/ESS gates under recorded seeds; site-5 passes using priors selected only from observed-site reference rows; NHANES locked cohort gate passes with no conditional offenders; all 20 skew-heavy comparator fits have zero critical warnings and the scenario is classified only from regenerated evidence; focused and full package checks pass; evidence and provenance are committed and pushed.
notes: Registered thresholds unchanged. Final receipts: HBR base/transfer zero divergences with R-hat 1.00 and ESS above 1700; observed-site-only prior selection chose location_prior_n=0 and scale_prior_n=25 and site-5 passed; NHANES full gate passed; 20/20 skew-heavy comparator fits valid with zero critical warnings and independent confirmation classified superior. Validation: fixture drift exact; focused tests 158/158 plus strengthened workflow 22/22; full testthat 1170 pass with two environment binary-version warnings; final R CMD check --no-manual --as-cran completed with only expected New submission NOTE.

title: Publish tiered CI and documentation evidence
description: Add fast offline PR checks, scheduled comparator regeneration and scenario runs, release-level HBR and multisite gates, machine-readable reports, and reader-facing evidence tables.
design: Pinned fixtures remain stable until an explicit comparator upgrade. CI reports exact conformance separately from scientific superiority and unsupported lanes.
acceptance_criteria: CI has documented PR, scheduled, and release tiers; the vignette links evidence and limitations; an upgrade produces reviewed drift rather than silently replacing baselines.
close_reason: Added offline PR oracles, weekly pinned regeneration/drift rejection, release HBR/site gates, reproducible machine-readable evidence, and linked reader-facing documentation

title: Evaluate HBR SHASH and site transport separately
description: Add scheduled evidence for HBR posterior aggregation, SHASH fitted performance, site effects, unseen-site transport, and Referent adaptation without claiming false rowwise equivalence.
design: Require convergence and Monte Carlo receipts. Use leave-one-site-out calibration and performance; keep PCNtoolkit transfer and Referent adaptation labeled as different estimands.
acceptance_criteria: HBR and transport reports expose convergence, uncertainty, score and calibration evidence, and no small-site failure is averaged away.
close_reason: HBR/transfer runner emits proper mixture and draw-averaged outputs, convergence receipts, per-site evidence, and a smoke run proved both convergence and small-site gates fail closed; release-grade evidence remains CI-gated

title: Establish held-out superiority and non-inferiority gates
description: Implement preregistered synthetic scenario families, untouched test splits, paired proper-score comparisons, cluster-aware uncertainty, calibration non-inferiority gates, and negative controls.
design: A differing Referent method is superior only when its paired held-out proper-score interval clears a practical margin and no marginal, conditional, site, or tail calibration gate materially regresses.
acceptance_criteria: The benchmark classifies conformant, equivalent, superior, trade-off, and inferior outcomes; null and deliberately overconfident negative controls behave correctly.
close_reason: Locked design registry, cluster bootstrap, calibration non-inferiority, full classification rules, and negative controls pass; skew-heavy held-out case is superior with positive log-score CI and better calibration

title: Certify fitted-model concordance in overlap cases
description: Compare identical train and test rows for intercept-only, linear, categorical, heteroskedastic, smooth, transformed, and balanced-site model configurations using per-row predictive outputs.
design: Use normalized prediction error, predictive-scale error, Z RMSE, central quantile errors, log tails, and coverage. Avoid a sole maximum-error gate.
acceptance_criteria: All registered overlap cases meet locked scenario-level concordance margins or have a documented non-equivalent classification.
close_reason: Four matched linear/log Gaussian scenarios meet all locked prediction, scale, Z, tail-quantile, and coverage margins; divergent smooth/site cases are explicitly diagnostic

title: Prove exact shared distribution and metric semantics
description: Add analytic and differential tests for Gaussian, SHASHb to mgcv SHASH conversion, transforms, log tails, log densities, and explicitly normalized metric definitions.
design: Use independent analytic formulas alongside external fixtures. Expected definition differences must be tested as differences, not hidden by broad tolerances.
acceptance_criteria: Gaussian and SHASH semantic fixtures pass scale-aware declared tolerances, adversarial tails remain finite, and metric relationships are independently verified.
close_reason: Independent R analytic, Referent, and pinned PCNtoolkit paths agree for Gaussian/converted SHASH/transforms; tail and definition-difference tests pass

title: Build reproducible offline PCNtoolkit fixture harness
description: Add a pinned Python generator, neutral inputs, checked-in per-row PCNtoolkit outputs, provenance receipts, and an R comparison reader without adding Python to normal package tests.
design: PCNtoolkit runs only during explicit regeneration or scheduled CI. Checked-in fixtures are versioned by comparator release and carry hashes and resolved environment metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture generation is deterministic; schema and hashes validate in R; normal testthat runs need no Python or network.
close_reason: Pinned Python generator is byte-stable across two runs; checked-in fixture manifest, schema, hashes, and offline R validation pass

title: Define pinned PCNtoolkit validation contract
description: Write the normative comparison contract for PCNtoolkit 1.3.0, classify outputs as exact, parameter-converted, matched-estimator, same-estimand, or non-equivalent, and reconcile the public comparison vignette with executed definitions.
design: Separate semantic conformance from scientific superiority. Record conditional versus total uncertainty and executed versus documented comparator behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewed design document and corrected vignette define every comparison lane, estimand, output, uncertainty mode, and mismatch disposition.
close_reason: Pinned comparison contract and corrected current PCNtoolkit 1.3.0 semantics in the public vignette

title: Establish PCNtoolkit conformance and superiority evidence
description: Implement the seven-part validation program: pin and document comparison contracts, generate reproducible PCNtoolkit fixtures, prove exact shared semantics, measure fitted-model concordance, establish held-out superiority without sacrificing calibration, evaluate HBR and site transport separately, and publish tiered CI evidence.
design: PCNtoolkit is an external differential oracle only for shared contracts. Alternative Referent methods may diverge when paired held-out proper-score superiority and calibration non-inferiority are demonstrated. Normal R tests consume offline fixtures; Python regeneration is scheduled or manual.
acceptance_criteria: All seven child work packages are complete; exact relationships pass declared tolerances; every mismatch is classified; superiority claims use untouched test data and calibration gates; normal R tests remain Python-free; documentation and CI expose evidence tiers.
close_reason: All seven PCNtoolkit conformance and superiority evidence lanes implemented and validated

acceptance_criteria: All public vignette pages use current exported APIs and render successfully; newcomer journey, task navigation, interpretation, and recovery are materially stronger than the live PCNtoolkit stable site; representative pages are compared at desktop and mobile viewports; repository tests and documentation build pass; intended changes are committed and pushed with tracking/live SHA verification.

title: Close WM-hypointensities MSLL gap vs information-matched PCN opponent
description: referent -0.470 vs fair opponent -0.491. Test-split var_z 1.17-1.23 indicates 10-20 pct out-of-sample overconfidence. Try norm_calibrate on out-of-fold train scores (train-only) before rescoring.
close_reason: Closed via ref_spec(transform=) Box-Cox response transform (commit 4dd3683). WM -0.49154 vs PCN fair -0.49087. NOTE: margin is +0.00068 nats with paired per-subject SE 0.033 (t=-0.02) - a point-estimate win only, not statistical evidence. Root cause was a missing capability, not tuning: SHASH moves conditional residual shape; PCN's warp is a monotone map on y.
